# Belarus basemap fixture

This Protomaps v4 extract covers `26,53,29,55` at zooms 0–6. It was made with
`pmtiles extract https://build.protomaps.com/20261118.pmtiles belarus.pmtiles --bbox=26,53,29,55 --maxzoom=6`.
It lets browser tests verify actual vector tiles and glyph requests with network access restricted to the test instance.

It is a Produced Work from [OpenStreetMap data](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright)
under the [Open Database License](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/).
